transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I’m here because lately, after a long shift or when I’m done studying, I’ll just… eat way more than I meant to. Like, I’ll have a whole fast-food meal, then snacks, then start going through whatever’s in the fridge, all in one sitting. It’s been happening enough that I’m getting concerned.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during these episodes?

Yeah. Once I start on those nights, it really feels like I can’t stop. Like my hands just keep grabbing more food even while I’m thinking, “stop, you’re already feeling sick.” It’s like I’m not in control of it.
Have these episodes of eating more than you meant to happened more than once?

Yeah, definitely more than once. Most weeks there’s at least one night where it happens, and then I try to make up for it somehow — like throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or exercising extra. It’s been going on for several months now.
Have you ever had these episodes of eating way more than you meant to without then trying to make up for it, like by throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or exercising extra?

Not really. Most weeks when I have one of those nights where I eat like that, I end up trying to make up for it afterward—throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. That’s been the pattern for several months now.
How often do you have these episodes of eating way more than you meant to?
Most weeks it’s at least one night. Like, I’ll eat way more than I meant to, and then I usually try to make up for it after. It’s been going on like that for several months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to every time they happen?

Pretty much, yeah. Most weeks when I have a night where I eat like that, I do try to make up for it after — usually by throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or working out more. It’s been going on for several months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes every single time they happen?

Not every single time, no. But most weeks, if I have a night where I eat like that, I do end up trying to make up for it somehow — throwing up, laxatives, not eating, or working out extra. It’s been going on for a few months.
How often do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to?

Most weeks, it’s at least once. I’ll have a night where I eat like that, and then I try to make up for it somehow — throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months now.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to at least once a week?

Yeah. Most weeks it’s at least once — I’ll have a night where I eat too much, and then I try to make up for it somehow, like throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been happening for several months now.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to every week?

Yeah, pretty much every week. Most weeks there’s at least one night where I eat like that, and then I try to make up for it somehow — throwing up, laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to at least three times a week?
I’m not really sure it’s that often. I know it happens most weeks, but I don’t think I’ve kept track closely enough to say it’s three times a week.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to by throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or exercising extra at least twice a week?

I don’t know if it’s twice every week. Most weeks it’s at least one night where I eat too much and then try to make up for it—throwing up, laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been like that for several months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to at least once a week for the past three months?

Yeah. At least once a week, most weeks. Usually there’s one night where I eat like that, and then I try to make up for it somehow—throwing up, laxatives, skipping meals, or exercising more. It’s been going on for a few months now.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to almost every day?

No, not almost every day. It’s more like most weeks there’s at least one night where I eat like that, and then I try to make up for it somehow—throwing up, laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to every time they happen, or are there times when you don't try to make up for them?

Not every single time, no. But most weeks there’s at least one night where I eat too much and then I do try to make up for it somehow—like throwing up, using laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to at least once a week for the past three months?

Yes. Like I said, most weeks I have at least one night where I eat like that, and then I try to make up for it—throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months now.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to at least once a week for the past three months consistently?

Yes. Pretty much every week, at least once, I have a night where I eat more than I meant to, and then I try to make up for it—throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to at least three times a month?

Yeah, at least three times a month. Most weeks it’s one night where I eat like that, and then I try to make up for it somehow—throwing up, laxatives, skipping meals, or exercising more. It’s been going on for months.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to more than once a week?

Usually it’s about once a week, like one night most weeks. After that I try to make up for it by throwing up, using laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months now.
Do you try to make up for these episodes of eating more than you meant to every single week?

Yeah, pretty much every week. Most weeks there’s at least one night where I eat like that, and then I try to make up for it—like throwing up, taking laxatives, skipping meals, or working out extra. It’s been going on for several months.
